summary.overview: The TSG Weekly Update meeting focused on several key areas, beginning with updates on the deal process, where participants discussed the need for information regarding Zif Davis. A concern was raised about the existence of two separate data rooms—one updated for Zif Davis and another older version for Coolco—leading to confusion about sharing consistent information with potential buyers. The team noted that Coolco remains interested, with renewed engagement from Zach, while Omnicom has yet to provide direct feedback. A firm deadline for offers was established for the 14th, allowing buyers the option to submit an Indication of Interest instead of a Letter of Intent. Action items include Andrew calling Chris to clarify data room details and Stuart reaching out to assist with any data sharing questions, while Matt offered to step in if needed. Overall, the meeting emphasized the importance of timely communication and clarity in the ongoing deal process.
